data.name: Fleezah
data.gender_notes: Fleezah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Fleezah is a beautiful Arabic name for girls that means creamy, soft, and tender. It is derived from the Arabic word 'al-falaj' which means well or spring. This name evokes images of lush greenery, soft petals, and soothing textures. It is a perfect name for a little girl who is sweet, gentle, and delicate, and who will grow up to be a source of comfort and nourishment to those around her.
data.spiritual_meaning: Fleezah is a name that embodies the softness and tenderness of God's love. It is a reminder of the gentle and comforting nature of the Divine, and a reflection of the soothing and nurturing qualities that are essential to our spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Fleezah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Creamy, soft, tender.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fleezah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
